entities.summary: Tanzan Shrine , also known as the Danzan Shrine, the Tōnomine Shrine  and the Tōnomine Temple , is a Shinto shrine in Sakurai, Nara Prefecture, Japan. It is located 5km from Ishibutai Kofun.
